------
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

----- 
For the Petitioner : M/s. A. K. Pandey, Advocate For the State : M/s. A, P. Topno, A.P.P For the O.P.
No.2 : M/s. Ranish Kumar, Advocate
---
07/12.06.2023

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Mahila P. S. Sakschi Case No. 28/2022,
registered under Sections 498A/ 313/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 03/4 of the D. P. Act,
pending in the Court of Sri Richesh Kumar learned J.M.F.C., Jamshedpur.
Petitioner is the husband of the informant.

It was submitted that the police submitted final form in this case but the learned court below after going through the materials available on the record took cognizance of this case under Section 498A of the Indian penal Code.
It was further submitted that the informant has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.
Learned lawyer for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case and that the police has submitted final form in this case and that the informant has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/-
